limitation: Two separate time windows, same exact strategy ID. Combined rows are descriptive only, not a matched policy comparison; 16 older recovered games are not the full 34-row historical elite manifest.

definitions.tree_turns: Sum of owned living tree counts over replay states 1..terminal; directly observed.
definitions.tree_income: Sum of current-frame obs.trees[tree_id][1] over current owner trees; recorded tree absorption income, excludes collision cash paid directly to a tree owner.
definitions.plant_cost: Current turn price fixed from previous state living global tree count per Board.next; same-turn plantings use the same price.
definitions.recruit_cost: Successful base commands simulated in base order from previous cash/population, before movement/collision; includes recruits dying in the same turn; all increment-cost settings checked as zero.
definitions.net_tree_cash_difference: Recorded tree absorption minus planting and seizing costs, own minus opponent. Descriptive accounting category, not counterfactual investment value.
definitions.non_tree_cash_inflow: Residual: cash change plus recruitment/planting/seizing costs minus recorded tree absorption. Includes deposits, collision cash (including tree-cell collisions), and rounding; NOT a direct deposit measurement.
definitions.disappeared_worker_cargo: Cargo before worker disappears; may be recovered by friendly collision or paid to a tree/base; NOT net economic loss.
definitions.cash_plus_cargo: Cash plus currently carried cargo; excludes future tree income, worker value, transport risk, and costs; not a complete state valuation.
definitions.comparison: Each own/opponent difference is paired within the same game; comparing Artemis group and v9 group against a common opponent still uses different unpaired maps.
